# Sample Project

A tool for doing awesome things.

## Installation

```bash
npm install sample-project
```

## Usage

```javascript
import { greet } from 'sample-project';

const message = greet('World');
console.log(message);
```

## API Reference

### `greet(name)`

Returns a greeting message.

```javascript
greet('Developer');
// => "Hello, Developer!"
```

## Configuration

```json
{
  "theme": "dark",
  "verbose": true
}
```
